models.label: Jackson running, swim brief
models.note: Same swim-brief model, 'Run' clip: looping 0.73 s run cycle in place (flight phase, knee drive, ~90° elbows pumping, forward lean, bounce, hip/shoulder counter-rotation), head stays upright; autoplays

models.label: Jackson, MotionBricks motion
models.note: Same swim-brief model, 'MotionBricks' clip: 7.3 s loop generated by NVIDIA MotionBricks (SOMA weights, run on CPU via ONNX Runtime) - jog straight, then run a full circle turn - retargeted onto the 17-bone rig, in place; head rigid and unscaled; autoplays

models.label: Jackson, jammers
models.note: Olympic-style swimmer: sculpted bare athletic torso/arms/legs, navy knee-length competition jammers with red side stripe and white trim, swim slides; same head as v4 (no cap/goggles); rigged (17 bones) with looping 2.4 s walk, autoplays; ~100k-face body, meshopt

models.label: Swimmer, one-piece
models.note: Original fictional athletic woman swimmer: MPFB2/MakeHuman-parametric adult female body, navy racing one-piece (thin spaghetti straps, scoop front, racerback, competition leg cut, small US flag patch on the chest, no logos), hair in a bun, swim slides; no cap/goggles. Rigged with the 17-bone skeleton + 2 chest helper bones and 2 glute helper bones (damped-spring secondary motion); clips Walk, Run, MotionBricks (female-gait adjusted retarget); autoplays MotionBricks; meshopt

models.label: Yoga: Deep Squat (malasana)
models.note: Deep squat (malasana) for the swimmer: motion generated with NVIDIA Kimodo from a text prompt and retargeted onto the 21-bone rig, with knee/hip helper bones for clean deep-bend deformation; stand, lower, hold ~3 s with gentle breathing, return; loops automatically, meshopt

models.label: Jackson - Hunyuan3D textured
models.note: Textured (2048px base color + metallic/roughness), meshopt geometry

models.label: Yoga: Warrior II (Virabhadrasana II)
models.note: Swimmer in a looping Warrior II: steps wide, front knee bent over the ankle, arms extended, gaze over the front hand, holds with gentle breathing and a soft relaxed smile (morph target), returns to standing. Feet planted by IK, subtle bust/glute spring bones; autoplays and loops. Hand-posed (Kimodo did not produce a wide stance); meshopt

models.label: Yoga: Puppy Pose (Uttana Shishosana)
models.note: Swimmer in a looping Puppy pose: stands, kneels with knees hip-width and thighs vertical, walks the hands forward and lowers chest and forehead toward the floor with hips high, holds with gentle breathing and a soft relaxed smile (morph target), then returns to standing. Knees and feet planted by IK; autoplays and loops; best viewed from the side or 3/4 front; meshopt

models.label: Yoga: Downward Dog (Adho Mukha Svanasana)
models.note: Swimmer in a looping Downward Dog: stands, folds forward, walks the hands out and lifts the hips into an inverted V with long straight arms and legs, holds with gentle breathing and a soft relaxed smile (morph target), then walks back to standing. Hands and feet planted by IK; autoplays and loops; best viewed from the side or 3/4; meshopt

models.label: Yoga: Tree Pose (Vrksasana)
models.note: Swimmer in a looping Tree pose: shifts onto the left leg, places the right foot high on the inner thigh with the knee turned out, raises the palms together overhead, holds with gentle breathing and a soft relaxed smile (morph target), then lowers back to standing. Standing foot planted by IK; autoplays and loops; best viewed from the front or 3/4; meshopt

models.label: Yoga: Child's Pose (Balasana)
models.note: Swimmer in a looping Child's pose: lowers from standing through a lunge to kneeling, sits back toward her heels, folds forward with arms extended and forehead toward the floor, holds with gentle breathing and a soft relaxed smile (morph target), then returns to standing. Hand-posed with IK; autoplays and loops; best viewed from the side or 3/4; meshopt
